concerns.text: Task T006 downloads poll data only from FiveThirtyEight and explicitly excludes RealClearPolitics, thereby weakening FR-001 which mandates ingestion from both FiveThirtyEight *and* RealClearPolitics.
No task ensures that random seeds are pinned in all scripts, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires deterministic seed setting for reproducibility.

The pipeline records hashes for derived files (T018/T019) but lacks any task that computes and records checksums for the raw downloaded poll files, breaching Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) that mandates raw data to be checksummed.
